title: Oven dial: marks 1-9 to degrees
body:
The dial on my gas oven has marks 1-9 and no degrees. Starting point: the British gas mark scale. It is a generic table, not measured on this oven: gas ovens run 10-20 °C off and hotter at the top.

To measure: put an oven thermometer on the middle shelf, set one mark, wait 15 minutes, write the reading here as a new version and set `measured` to true.

| Mark | °C | Use |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 140 | slow drying, meringue |
| 2 | 150 | slow roasting |
| 3 | 170 | cakes, sponge |
| 4 | 180 | most baking, casseroles |
| 5 | 190 | meat in foil, chicken |
| 6 | 200 | vegetables, crisp chicken |
| 7 | 220 | browning, crust |
| 8 | 230 | pizza, quick roasting |
| 9 | 240 | maximum |
